newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cerus weaker after CGIP denies bid.
newsitem.headline: Cerus weaker after CGIP denies bid.

text.p: Cerus was down seven percent at 124.0 francs in early afternoon trade on Wednesday following French industrial firm CGIP's denial on Tuesday that it planned to launch a takeover bid for the French holding company.
CGIP was also weaker, off 1.18 percent at 1,175 francs.
However, newspaper Les Echos on Wedneday quoted CGIP chairman as confirming that the company was interested in the 28 percent of French car parts maker Valeo which Cerus holds.
Les Echos said the matter could be resolved in early October following board meetings of the various companies involved. Valeo was off 0.04 percent at 279.50 francs.
